title: Yellow Team — Slot reel A
description: Yellow Team’s 18 portraits spin in one column, bounce gently, and settle on photo 15. An 8-second motion test.

title: Yellow Team — Slot reel B
description: The same Yellow Team reel with a longer slowdown and a stronger mechanical bounce, ending on photo 15. An 11-second motion test.

title: All teams — Paper confetti
description: 54 portraits, nine from each team, mix through one reel and slow to a mechanical bounce. Photo 15 from Yellow Team lands alone in the center. Six-color paper confetti flutters and tumbles around the portrait.

title: All teams — Color bloom
description: 54 portraits, nine from each team, mix through one reel and slow to a mechanical bounce. Photo 15 from Yellow Team lands alone in the center. Six team colors bloom around the portrait.

title: All teams — Paper confetti · Neighbors visible
description: 54 portraits, nine from each team, mix through one reel and slow to a mechanical bounce. Photo 88 from Blue Team lands in the center, with neighboring portraits still visible above and below. Six-color paper confetti flutters and tumbles around the portrait.

title: All teams — Color bloom · Neighbors visible
description: 54 portraits, nine from each team, mix through one reel and slow to a mechanical bounce. Photo 88 from Blue Team lands in the center, with neighboring portraits still visible above and below. Six team colors bloom around the portrait.

title: Blue Team — Confetti shower
description: 54 mixed-team portraits settle two seconds sooner on Blue Team photo 88. A dense six-color shower of textured paper confetti sweeps in front of the portrait and continues through the longer celebration. The selected portrait finishes alone in the center.

title: Blue Team — Confetti shower · Neighbors visible
description: 54 mixed-team portraits settle two seconds sooner on Blue Team photo 88. A dense six-color shower of textured paper confetti sweeps in front of the portrait and continues through the longer celebration. Neighboring portraits remain partially visible above and below.

title: Blue Team — Analog party poppers
description: Two unevenly timed party-popper bursts release clumps of textured paper that separate, tumble, and drift. Warm, uneven interior lighting and an imperfect mechanical landing. Blue Team photo 88 stays centered with neighboring portraits visible.

title: Blue Team — Analog paper drift
description: Loose waves of textured paper float through changing air currents, with soft pieces passing close to the camera. Warm, uneven interior lighting and an imperfect mechanical landing. Blue Team photo 88 stays centered with neighboring portraits visible.

title: Blue Team — Six pieces · Gentle sway
description: Exactly six large pieces of paper, one in each team color, released from the top at closely spaced, uneven times. A gentle feather-like sway carries them all the way off the bottom. Blue Team photo 88, visible neighboring portraits, and warm interior lighting.

title: Blue Team — Six pieces · Slow turns
description: Exactly six large pieces of paper, one in each team color, released from the top at closely spaced, uneven times. Slow turns and broad drifting curves carry them all the way off the bottom. Blue Team photo 88, visible neighboring portraits, and warm interior lighting.

title: Blue Team — Digital · Neon Circuit
description: Cyan and magenta circuit rails turn into six-color light chases, with expanding neon frames around the winning portrait. The same 54-photo reel lands on Blue Team photo 88 at 12 seconds, with neighboring portraits visible.

title: Blue Team — Digital · Prism Jackpot
description: Six jewel-colored light banks pulse around the frame while colorful rays burst outward from the winning portrait. The same 54-photo reel lands on Blue Team photo 88 at 12 seconds, with neighboring portraits visible.

title: Blue Team — Digital · Orbit
description: Glowing arcs, orbiting lights, and shimmering points circle the winning portrait in six team colors. The same 54-photo reel lands on Blue Team photo 88 at 12 seconds, with neighboring portraits visible.

title: Blue Team — Digital · Pixel Party
description: A digital LED matrix sends color waves around the screen, with blinking pixel rails and expanding corner lights around the winner. The same 54-photo reel lands on Blue Team photo 88 at 12 seconds, with neighboring portraits visible.

title: Disco A — Mirrorball
description: Warm octave bass, crisp handclaps, offbeat guitar, and bright disco strings. An original 120 BPM music test on the same Neon Circuit video. The musical accent lands with the winning portrait at 12 seconds.

title: Disco B — Neon Boogie
description: A punchier electronic groove with elastic bass, syncopated synth chords, and a bright arpeggio. An original 120 BPM music test on the same Neon Circuit video. The musical accent lands with the winning portrait at 12 seconds.

title: Disco C — Pocket Funk
description: A playful, lightly swung groove with clipped clavinet, cowbell, and a busier bass line. An original 120 BPM music test on the same Neon Circuit video. The musical accent lands with the winning portrait at 12 seconds.

title: Disco D — Space Disco
description: Airy electric keys, shimmering synths, a steady dance pulse, and a wide celebratory lift. An original 120 BPM music test on the same Neon Circuit video. The musical accent lands with the winning portrait at 12 seconds.

title: Blue Team — Neon Circuit · Disco D
description: Blue and cyan neon rails, animated light chases, and expanding frames. The accents slowly blend through team colors and settle on blue as the portrait lands. The same Disco D soundtrack accompanies all four versions, with the winning portrait and musical accent at 12 seconds.

title: Blue Team — Prism Jackpot · Disco D
description: Jewel-colored light banks and outward rays against a blue background. The accents slowly blend through team colors and settle on blue as the portrait lands. The same Disco D soundtrack accompanies all four versions, with the winning portrait and musical accent at 12 seconds.

title: Blue Team — Orbit · Disco D
description: Glowing rings and orbiting lights in a cool blue surround. The accents slowly blend through team colors and settle on blue as the portrait lands. The same Disco D soundtrack accompanies all four versions, with the winning portrait and musical accent at 12 seconds.

title: Blue Team — Pixel Party · Disco D
description: Blinking LED patterns and color waves against a blue background. The accents slowly blend through team colors and settle on blue as the portrait lands. The same Disco D soundtrack accompanies all four versions, with the winning portrait and musical accent at 12 seconds.

title: Six teams — Together · Disco D
description: Six reels land together on the 12-second musical accent. One expressive winning portrait per team. All 108 approved headshots appear across the six mixed-color reels. Neon Circuit, Prism Jackpot, Orbit, and Pixel Party are joined by music-responsive Spectrum bars and a rotating Mirrorball. The three versions use the same six winners and identical Disco D audio.

title: Six teams — Color Cascade · Disco D
description: The winning portraits land from left to right, one per beat from 9.5 to 12 seconds. One expressive winning portrait per team. All 108 approved headshots appear across the six mixed-color reels. Neon Circuit, Prism Jackpot, Orbit, and Pixel Party are joined by music-responsive Spectrum bars and a rotating Mirrorball. The three versions use the same six winners and identical Disco D audio.

title: Six teams — Center Out · Disco D
description: The middle pair lands first, then the next pair, then the outside pair—at 10, 11, and 12 seconds. One expressive winning portrait per team. All 108 approved headshots appear across the six mixed-color reels. Neon Circuit, Prism Jackpot, Orbit, and Pixel Party are joined by music-responsive Spectrum bars and a rotating Mirrorball. The three versions use the same six winners and identical Disco D audio.

title: One machine — Slow Bloom · Disco D
description: The cabinet slowly cycles through the six team colors, one at a time, then opens into a broad six-color bloom. Six independent reels spin at different speeds and stop in their own time. The last stop completes one portrait per team color at 10 seconds on the Disco D hit, triggering five seconds of an all-color celebration. No text. All three variations use the same reel motion and music.
audio: Disco D — Full Row Hit, 120 BPM

title: One machine — Color Sweep · Disco D
description: Waves of a single color sweep across the machine, cycling through all six colors before a giant six-color fan bursts open. Six independent reels spin at different speeds and stop in their own time. The last stop completes one portrait per team color at 10 seconds on the Disco D hit, triggering five seconds of an all-color celebration. No text. All three variations use the same reel motion and music.

title: One machine — Color Rush · Disco D
description: One-color pulses accelerate through two cycles of all six team colors, then explode into a six-color starburst. Six independent reels spin at different speeds and stop in their own time. The last stop completes one portrait per team color at 10 seconds on the Disco D hit, triggering five seconds of an all-color celebration. No text. All three variations use the same reel motion and music.
audio: Disco D — Full Row Hit, 120 BPM

title: Vertical — Six-window machine · Disco D
description: Six independent reels share one vertical cabinet in two columns and three rows. Each stops on a different team color; the final stop at ten seconds triggers the six-color celebration. All 108 approved portraits appear across the reels. All three use the same six winners and identical Disco D music, with five seconds of celebration. Full square portraits, no text, ready for vertical social posts.
audio: Disco D — Full Row Hit, 120 BPM

title: Vertical — One reel builds six · Disco D
description: One large reel selects each team’s portrait, which shrinks into a growing collection below. The final portrait joins the others as the six-person grid expands into place on the ten-second music hit. All three use the same six winners and identical Disco D music, with five seconds of celebration. Full square portraits, no text, ready for vertical social posts.

title: Vertical — Two reels, three rounds · Disco D
description: Two large reels are stacked vertically. Three rounds feature Yellow and Red, Green and Pink, then Blue and Purple. They become one six-person grid on the ten-second music hit. All three use the same six winners and identical Disco D music, with five seconds of celebration. Full square portraits, no text, ready for vertical social posts.
audio: Disco D — Full Row Hit, 120 BPM

title: Vertical — Neon Arcade · Disco D
description: Neon tubes, traveling light in the gutters, angular circuit paths and a six-color laser-ring celebration. Based on 48: six independent reels, all 108 portraits, the same six winners, and identical Disco D music. Fifteen seconds, with the final stop at ten seconds and five seconds of celebration. Full square portraits and no text.

description: Soft luminous ribbons flow around the cabinet and through the colored gutters, opening into six flowing colors on the win. description: A pixel display with moving LED gutters, equalizer bars and a six-color diamond-and-pixel burst. title: 36 posters — Flat ribbon
description: All 36 opportunity posters touch edge to edge and move continuously left to right. A straight ribbon fills the frame. Green → Purple → Red → Blue → Yellow → Pink, repeated six times. A new poster crosses the center every five seconds. Three-minute seamless loop; silent.

title: 36 posters — Curved carousel
description: All 36 opportunity posters touch edge to edge and move continuously left to right. A large curved carousel recedes at the sides, with each complete poster visible at the center. Green → Purple → Red → Blue → Yellow → Pink, repeated six times. A new poster crosses the center every five seconds. Three-minute seamless loop; silent.

title: Feasibility slides — Curved carousel
description: Green → Purple → Red → Blue → Yellow → Pink, alternating every three seconds. Slides travel right to left in normal reading order, with each team’s pages progressing forward. Each slide appears once; teams leave the rotation as they finish. Full HD, silent, seamless loop.

title: Puzzle photos — Vertical two pieces
description: Two large photo-filled pieces slide from above and below and lock along a stepped edge, following the sketch. Edge-to-edge photographs, no added text, silent.

title: Puzzle photos — Vertical three bands
description: Three photographic bands enter from alternating sides and interlock through rectangular tabs. The assembled photos fill the vertical frame. No added text, silent.

title: Puzzle photos — Square four corners
description: Four photographs approach from the corners and join as a single square mosaic with interlocking stepped edges. No added text, silent.

title: Puzzle photos — Square photo reassembly
description: Each photograph is divided into nine rectilinear puzzle pieces. The pieces arrive in a staggered spiral and assemble into one full-frame photograph. No added text, silent.

title: Puzzle photos — Landscape sketch
description: The closest interpretation of the drawing: three full-height photographs occupy complementary notched shapes and slide vertically into place. No added text, silent.

title: Puzzle photos — Landscape six-piece wave
description: Six photos assemble as a borderless interlocking mosaic. Alternating pieces enter from above and below in a left-to-right wave. No added text, silent.

title: String tests — horizontal glide
description: One red string travels straight across the square from left to right. Rounded ends and diagonal shading follow the supplied artwork.

title: String tests — vertical rise
description: One blue string rises vertically through the frame, with its shaded bands traveling with it.

title: String tests — diagonal pass
description: One yellow string travels diagonally from the lower left to the upper right.

title: String tests — traveling wave
description: A broad wave travels along a single green string that stretches beyond both sides of the frame.

title: String tests — standing wave
description: A single purple string has still ends and a moving middle. Two opposing bends pass smoothly through a straight line.

title: String tests — downward ripple
description: A soft S-shaped ripple travels down a single pink string that extends beyond the top and bottom.

title: String tests — around the frame
description: One blue string follows a rounded rectangular route around the inside of the frame, turning each corner without a cut.

title: String tests — open orbit
description: One open red arc circles the center. The gap stays open throughout the rotation; there are no crossings or knots.

title: String tests — elastic bend
description: One green string bends from a straight line into a deep open curve and relaxes back. Its centerline length stays constant.

title: String tests 2 — horizontal feed
description: A red string feeds continuously from the left edge to the right edge. The diagonal bands travel steadily with the string; neither end appears.

title: String tests 2 — upward feed
description: A blue string feeds continuously in through the bottom and out through the top. No pauses or visible ends.

title: String tests 2 — diagonal feed
description: A yellow string travels continuously from the lower left to the upper right, extending beyond the frame at both ends.

title: String tests 2 — flowing wave
description: A green string keeps feeding left to right while broad waves travel along it. The string crosses both edges throughout the loop.

title: String tests 2 — falling ripple
description: A pink string feeds continuously downward as an S-shaped ripple travels from top to bottom. Both ends stay outside the frame.

title: String tests 2 — over the arch
description: A purple string flows in from the left, over a gently breathing arch, and out to the right. Its shaded bands make the continuous feed visible.

title: String tests 2 — round the corner
description: A yellow string enters from the left, turns a broad rounded corner, and feeds out through the bottom edge.

title: String tests 2 — continuous u-turn
description: A red string enters at the upper left, follows a wide U-turn, and exits at the lower left. One uninterrupted string keeps feeding around the bend.

title: String tests 2 — three-pass flow
description: A blue string enters from the left, follows three horizontal passes joined by rounded bends, and exits at the right. Continuous feed with no crossings.

title: Connect photo tests — together
description: Ten theme-balloon photographs connect from two complementary halves. Both sides glide in together along moving pink string edges. The string disappears at the join, followed by a two-second clean photo hold.

title: Connect photo tests — alternating lead
description: The same ten photographs join along moving string edges. One half leads and the other catches up, alternating left and right with each photo. The completed photograph holds for two seconds with the string gone.

title: Connect photo tests — floating join
description: The same ten photographs arrive as two pieces drifting from opposite sides and slightly different heights. Their moving string edges align and disappear, leaving each connected photo still for two seconds.

title: Connect photo tests — rope drops away
description: The photo halves connect, then the pink rope drops downward with an accelerating fall. Its rounded free end travels down and clears the bottom edge. Each clean photograph holds for two seconds.

title: Connect photo tests — rope pulled upward
description: The photo halves connect, then the pink rope tightens and is pulled upward. Its rounded trailing end follows it out through the top edge. Each clean photograph holds for two seconds.

title: Connect photo tests — upward pull, six colors
description: The rope changes color with every photo: Green → Purple → Red → Blue → Yellow → Pink, then repeats. Photo halves connect, and the matching rope tightens and is pulled upward. Same ten photos with two-second clean holds.
